title: drynaria morbillosa
intro: Drynaria morbillosa, commonly known as the Chinese mesoglossum or Chinese tuckahoe, is a type of terrestrial fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is a traditional medicinal plant used in Asian cultures, particularly in China and India, for its potential health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Drynaria morbillosa include polysaccharides, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
